description: This file defines the API function prototypes for managing DPoE (Distributed Point of Entry Ethernet) objects and their associated data models, including retrieving and setting parameter values, validation, commit, and rollback operations.
external_methods: slap_definitions.h (implied external data types and definitions)

methods.name: DPoE_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG parameter value for a DPoE object.

methods.name: DPoE_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets a ULONG parameter value for a DPoE object.

methods.name: DPoE_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for a DPoE object.

methods.name: DPoE_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value from a DPoE object.

methods.name: DPoE_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a BOOL parameter value for a DPoE object.

methods.name: DPoE_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a BOOL parameter value for a DPoE object.

methods.name: DPoE_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an INT parameter value for a DPoE object.

methods.name: DPoE_SetParamIntValue
methods.description: Sets an INT parameter value for a DPoE object.

methods.name: DPoE_Validate
methods.description: Validates the parameters before applying changes.

methods.name: DPoE_Commit
methods.description: Commits the current set of changes.

methods.name: DPoE_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back any uncommitted changes.

methods.name: DPoE_FirmwareInfo_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware info string parameters.

methods.name: DPoE_ChipInfo_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves the chip info string parameters.

methods.name: DPoE_ManufacturerInfo_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves the manufacturer info string parameters.

methods.name: DPoE_DeviceSysDescrInfo_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves the device system description string parameters.

methods.name: DPoE_OnuPacketBufferCapabilities_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves the ONU packet buffer capabilities.

methods.name: DPoE_LlidForwardingState_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of LLID forwarding state entries.

methods.name: DPoE_LlidForwardingState_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific LLID forwarding state entry by index.

methods.name: DPoE_LlidForwardingState_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a BOOL value for LLID forwarding state.

methods.name: DPoE_LlidForwardingState_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG value for LLID forwarding state.

methods.name: DPoE_OamFrameRate_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of OAM frame rate entries.

methods.name: DPoE_OamFrameRate_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific OAM frame rate entry by index.

methods.name: DPoE_OamFrameRate_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves the OAM frame rate value.

methods.name: DPoE_DynamicMacTable_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of dynamic MAC table entries.

methods.name: DPoE_DynamicMacTable_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific dynamic MAC table entry.

methods.name: DPoE_DynamicMacTable_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves string parameters for dynamic MAC table entries.

methods.name: DPoE_DynamicMacTable_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves ULONG parameters for dynamic MAC table entries.

methods.name: DPoE_StaticMacTable_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of static MAC table entries.

methods.name: DPoE_StaticMacTable_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific static MAC table entry.

methods.name: DPoE_StaticMacTable_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves ULONG parameters for static MAC table entries.

methods.name: DPoE_StaticMacTable_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves string parameters for static MAC table entries.

methods.name: DPoE_OnuLinkStatistics_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of ONU link statistics entries.

methods.name: DPoE_OnuLinkStatistics_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ONU link statistics entry.

methods.name: DPoE_OnuLinkStatistics_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves ULONG values for ONU link statistics.
